prelaunch_updates.text: TermiX: holders of a Binance Agent ID can install TermiX Skills through their linked agent and connect its Agentic Wallet for 50 TP (TermiX points), one reward per wallet. A new task inside the existing points campaign; TGE still undated, any TMT token now is a scam.

GenLayer published a revised GEN tokenomics paper (Wed 11/18): only 673.24M GEN (16.0% of supply) unlocks at TGE, down from 1,275.75M (30.4%). Foundation (840M) now 410.74M at TGE, 145.76M over months 1-2, 283.5M on the 48-month contributor schedule; Early Ecosystem 25% at TGE then 6.25%/month for 12 months. Supply (4.2B), allocation sizes, investor schedules and community airdrop terms unchanged; first-year issuance ~361M GEN (8.6%). TGE still undated; any GEN token now is a scam.

GenLayer restated Pre-Mainnet Staking: airdropped GEN counts from day one and, on THE DAY (launch day, still undated), starts staking automatically and earns Staking Points daily with no action needed. No token address or venue yet; any GEN token now is a scam.

Arthur Hayes: becoming a FLOP miner, validator, KOL or user needs no application or approval; point an AI agent at flop.finance/intro to get set up. Flop Labs shipped CLI v0.6.0 and Python SDK v0.3.2 and fixed devnet wallet enrollment. Testnet and airdrop still Tue 11/24 (tentative); devnet earns nothing. No token exists.

TermiX x Kaito creator campaign: total reward pool raised from 0.3% to 0.4% of the TermiX token supply and the campaign extended through TGE, with new epochs to come. TGE itself is still undated. Campaign already known (we are in TermiX Points); not a new campaign.

Arthur Hayes: FLOP block rewards are weighted by inference processed (measured in floating-point work); the team will not advise on miner hardware. Flop Labs released miner v0.2.0, miner-vllm-toploc v0.2.0 and SDK v0.5.2 on GitHub ahead of the tentative Tue 11/24 testnet. No token yet; any FLOP token is a scam.

Neptune Cash (NPT) dev update for Nov 16: post-quantum ML-DSA (Dilithium) signatures are now implemented in its TASM VM, and succinct block proofs are enforced on mainnet since block 62,500. Already trading (SafeTrade NPT/USDT), so this is a milestone note, not a launch.

GenLayer publicly asked CoinMarketCap to register two GenLayer emails to manage its self-reporting dashboard on CoinMarketCap (supply and project data). That points to listing prep, but there is still no launch date, token address or venue. CoinGecko's GEN preview page also shows an Ethereum token address GenLayer has not posted. Any GEN token before an official GenLayer post is a scam.

Dataline is partnering with ZKPassport for eligibility checks in the DAT public sale on Uniswap (CCA auction): you scan your passport chip and your phone produces a proof instead of uploading ID. Sale date, raise, FDV and vesting still not announced. This is a paid token sale, not a free campaign. Any DAT/Dataline token before an official token address is a scam.
Verona says its VDPs grew from 12.5M to 19.6M in under a month (about 309K a day) and that 'the next launch is bigger news'. No date or details of the launch yet.

X News summary and community posts: GenLayer's public chain finished moving from ZK Stack to Arbitrum Nitro, operated by Conduit; GenVM and Optimistic Democracy unchanged. No new @GenLayer post found in this sweep, so treat as unconfirmed. Still no launch date or token address; any GEN token now is a scam.
